today_news.title: OpenAI fixes Codex bug that deleted real user files without permission
today_news.summary: OpenAI patched Codex after GPT-5.6 Sol started deleting real user files on its own. A cleanup command meant for temporary folders was wiping home directories instead. Codex now verifies deletion targets first, and full-access mode can no longer be triggered by accident.

today_news.title: GLM-5.3 tops the open-model rankings and undercuts rivals on price, but its release is delayed
today_news.summary: GLM-5.3, the AI model from Chinese startup Z.ai, scores 60 points on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. That ties it with Kimi K3 for the top spot among open models, and it's seven points ahead of the previous GLM-5.2.

today_news.title: Attackers are using AI to build exploits for industrial control systems, U.S. agencies warn
today_news.summary: The NSA, CISA, and FBI say attackers are using AI to build exploit scripts targeting Siemens S7 controllers, drastically cutting the time and skill needed to attack industrial control systems. Critical U.S. sectors like energy, water, and manufacturing are affected.

today_news.title: China lets Nvidia's H200 chips trickle onto the mainland to help its AI firms keep pace with the US
today_news.summary: China is letting small batches of Nvidia's H200 chips onto the mainland to help domestic AI firms in the race with the US.
